description: The petals obtained by deleting the root of a delta-system are pairwise disjoint.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DeltaSystems.petals_disjoint.{u} {α : Type u} {A : Set (Set α)} {r : Set α}
  (hA : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DeltaSystems.IsDeltaSystem A r) : A.Pairwise fun a b => Disjoint (a \ r) (b \ r)
